paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura solemnly saw the messenger off. Giving the order was easy, but a safe withdrawal would require a plan even more meticulous than the attack itself. Ban Dan'emon, Gotō Matabei, Susukida Kanesuke, Kimura Shigenari, and others had either fallen in battle or were missing, their fate unknown. What had to be decided now was how the survivors should meet the battle on the morrow.

units.source_en: Yukimura solemnly saw the messenger off.
units.source_zh: 幸村郑重送走了使者。

units.source_en: Giving the order was easy, but a safe withdrawal would require a plan even more meticulous than the attack itself.
units.source_zh: 命令下起来容易，但想平安撤退，必须有一出比进攻还要周密的策略。

units.source_en: Ban Dan'emon, Gotō Matabei, Susukida Kanesuke, Kimura Shigenari, and others had either fallen in battle or were missing, their fate unknown.
units.source_zh: 塙团右卫门、后藤又兵卫、薄田兼相、木村重成等人或战死沙场，或生死不明。

units.source_en: What had to be decided now was how the survivors should meet the battle on the morrow.
units.source_zh: 目下要确定的，乃是剩下的人应如何应付明日的战事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村郑重送走了使者。命令下起来容易，但想平安撤退，必须有一出比进攻还要周密的策略。塙团右卫门、后藤又兵卫、薄田兼相、木村重成等人或战死沙场，或生死不明。目下要确定的，乃是剩下的人应如何应付明日的战事。

paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura then summoned the commanders to discuss the route of retreat.

units.source_en: Yukimura then summoned the commanders to discuss the route of retreat.
units.source_zh: 幸村随后召集诸将，商量撤退路线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村随后召集诸将，商量撤退路线。

paragraphs.source_en: What objection could any of the commanders have? The sooner they withdrew, naturally, the better. The army commanded by Matsudaira Tadateru likely numbered more than ten thousand; if it launched another attack, their own forces would be hard-pressed to withstand it.

units.source_en: What objection could any of the commanders have?

ja.t: があろうはずもなかった。

units.source_zh: 诸将还会有什么异议？

units.source_en: The sooner they withdrew, naturally, the better.
units.source_zh: 撤退，自是越早越好。

units.source_en: The army commanded by Matsudaira Tadateru likely numbered more than ten thousand; if it launched another attack, their own forces would be hard-pressed to withstand it.
units.source_zh: 松平忠辉统领的军队，人数怕在一万以上，要是遭到新一轮的攻击，己方殊难抵挡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 诸将还会有什么异议？撤退，自是越早越好。松平忠辉统领的军队，人数怕在一万以上，要是遭到新一轮的攻击，己方殊难抵挡。

paragraphs.source_en: “We shall withdraw at the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Monkey. Until then, let the men rest well.” Yukimura's tone remained as calm as still water.

units.source_en: “We shall withdraw at the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Monkey.
units.source_zh: “我们当于申时四刻撤退。

units.source_en: Until then, let the men rest well.”
units.source_zh: 在此之前，让士众好生歇息。”

units.source_en: Yukimura's tone remained as calm as still water.
units.source_zh: 幸村的口气依然平稳如水。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我们当于申时四刻撤退。在此之前，让士众好生歇息。”幸村的口气依然平稳如水。

paragraphs.source_en: Had Yukimura come under another fierce Kantō assault in the dense woods of Honda, the Osaka army might well have been annihilated that very day.

units.source_en: Had Yukimura come under another fierce Kantō assault in the dense woods of Honda, the Osaka army might well have been annihilated that very day.

ja.t: していたかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 幸村若在誉田的密林中遭到了关东新一轮猛攻，大坂军在这一日许已全军覆没了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村若在誉田的密林中遭到了关东新一轮猛攻，大坂军在这一日许已全军覆没了。

paragraphs.source_en: After the war, someone wrote of the matter as follows:

units.source_en: After the war, someone wrote of the matter as follows:
units.source_zh: 关于此事，战后有人这般记述：

paragraphs.source_zh: 关于此事，战后有人这般记述：

paragraphs.source_en: The reason Tadateru held his army back is now clear. Why, then, did Masamune deliberately restrain Tadateru and cause him to squander a chance to win distinction? As stated plainly before, Masamune was rumored to have embraced the Western faith; Osaka Castle, too, had been infiltrated by many priests and believers; and Tadateru had pestered Ieyasu to grant Osaka Castle to him as his fief. With suspicions multiplying on every side, Tadateru's great army naturally could not move an inch.

units.source_en: The reason Tadateru held his army back is now clear.
units.source_zh: 忠辉按兵不动的原因至此明了。

units.source_en: Why, then, did Masamune deliberately restrain Tadateru and cause him to squander a chance to win distinction?
units.source_zh: 那么，政宗为何故意阻止忠辉，致使他白白丧失了一次建功立业的机会？

units.source_en: As stated plainly before, Masamune was rumored to have embraced the Western faith;
units.source_zh: 前文已明言，政宗有入了洋教之说；

units.source_en: Osaka Castle, too, had been infiltrated by many priests and believers;
units.source_zh: 大坂城内亦已混入了大量神父和信徒；

units.source_en: and Tadateru had pestered Ieyasu to grant Osaka Castle to him as his fief.
units.source_zh: 忠辉亦曾缠着家康，要求把大坂城封给自己。

units.source_en: With suspicions multiplying on every side, Tadateru's great army naturally could not move an inch.
units.source_zh: 数疑并起，忠辉大军自是不能动得了半分。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠辉按兵不动的原因至此明了。那么，政宗为何故意阻止忠辉，致使他白白丧失了一次建功立业的机会？前文已明言，政宗有入了洋教之说；大坂城内亦已混入了大量神父和信徒；忠辉亦曾缠着家康，要求把大坂城封给自己。数疑并起，忠辉大军自是不能动得了半分。

paragraphs.source_en: But was that truly what happened?

units.source_en: But was that truly what happened?

ja.t: にそうだったのだろうか。

units.source_zh: 但事实是否果真如此？

paragraphs.source_zh: 但事实是否果真如此？

paragraphs.source_en: Tadateru halted his march and camped at Enmyōji Village, thereby missing the perfect opportunity to pursue the Western Army; yet the affair that later ruined his entire life was far from so simple.

units.source_en: Tadateru halted his march and camped at Enmyōji Village, thereby missing the perfect opportunity to pursue the Western Army; yet the affair that later ruined his entire life was far from so simple.
units.source_zh: 因为停止行军，宿营于圆明村，从而贻误了追击西军的大好机会，此事后来葬送了忠辉的一生，远无如此简单。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因为停止行军，宿营于圆明村，从而贻误了追击西军的大好机会，此事后来葬送了忠辉的一生，远无如此简单。

paragraphs.source_en: Hanai Mondo found this reasoning highly persuasive and returned to report it to Tadateru. Though he was a senior retainer, he had formerly been merely a Noh performer and likewise had little experience of warfare. Moreover, Tamamushi Tsushima and Hayashi Heinojō had already argued vehemently against it, so Tadateru suppressed his impatient urge to advance and rejected Minagawa Hiroteru's request to pursue the enemy.

units.source_en: Hanai Mondo found this reasoning highly persuasive and returned to report it to Tadateru.
units.source_zh: 花井主水听了这一番话，大觉有理，回去报告给了忠辉。

units.source_en: Though he was a senior retainer, he had formerly been merely a Noh performer and likewise had little experience of warfare.
units.source_zh: 他虽为家老，但先前却只是一个能剧艺人，作战经验同样不多。

units.source_en: Moreover, Tamamushi Tsushima and Hayashi Heinojō had already argued vehemently against it, so Tadateru suppressed his impatient urge to advance and rejected Minagawa Hiroteru's request to pursue the enemy.
units.source_zh: 加上之前玉虫对马和林平之丞等人也曾经极力反对，忠辉便亦压制住急躁冒进之心，驳了皆川广照的追敌之请。

paragraphs.source_zh: 花井主水听了这一番话，大觉有理，回去报告给了忠辉。他虽为家老，但先前却只是一个能剧艺人，作战经验同样不多。加上之前玉虫对马和林平之丞等人也曾经极力反对，忠辉便亦压制住急躁冒进之心，驳了皆川广照的追敌之请。

paragraphs.source_en: Date Masamune left Katakura and Okuyama to fight alone while he himself held his troops in place. Seeing the Sanada forces retreat toward the woods at Honda, Mizuno Katsushige appealed, “Now is the perfect moment to pursue the enemy. I ask that you join me in launching an attack.”

units.source_en: Date Masamune left Katakura and Okuyama to fight alone while he himself held his troops in place.
units.source_zh: 伊达政宗让片仓和奥山孤军奋战，自己按兵不动。

units.source_en: Seeing the Sanada forces retreat toward the woods at Honda, Mizuno Katsushige appealed, “Now is the perfect moment to pursue the enemy. I ask that you join me in launching an attack.”
units.source_zh: 见真田朝誉田的树林撤退，水野胜成请求道：“现在乃是追敌的大好机会，希望大人能与在下一起发动进攻。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊达政宗让片仓和奥山孤军奋战，自己按兵不动。见真田朝誉田的树林撤退，水野胜成请求道：“现在乃是追敌的大好机会，希望大人能与在下一起发动进攻。”

paragraphs.source_en: But Date Masamune refused sternly: “My troops have fought fiercely; men and horses alike are exhausted and cannot continue the battle.”

units.source_en: But Date Masamune refused sternly: “My troops have fought fiercely; men and horses alike are exhausted and cannot continue the battle.”
units.source_zh: 伊达政宗却严厉拒绝：“我部经过了激烈奋战，人马俱疲，无法继续为战。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊达政宗却严厉拒绝：“我部经过了激烈奋战，人马俱疲，无法继续为战。”

paragraphs.source_en: Mizuno Katsushige was, after all, the supreme commander of the Dōmyōji column, whose fighting strength was in no way inferior to Date's fourth column. Yet Masamune rejected him in severe terms and even demanded that Matsudaira Tadateru's fifth column refrain from rash action. What exactly was he scheming?

units.source_en: Mizuno Katsushige was, after all, the supreme commander of the Dōmyōji column, whose fighting strength was in no way inferior to Date's fourth column.
units.source_zh: 水野胜成怎说也是道明寺一路军的总大将，在战力上绝不输于四路的伊达。

units.source_en: Yet Masamune rejected him in severe terms and even demanded that Matsudaira Tadateru's fifth column refrain from rash action.
units.source_zh: 但政宗却严词拒绝，还要求第五路松平忠辉也莫要轻举妄动。

units.source_en: What exactly was he scheming?
units.source_zh: 他葫芦里究竟卖的什么药？

paragraphs.source_zh: 水野胜成怎说也是道明寺一路军的总大将，在战力上绝不输于四路的伊达。但政宗却严词拒绝，还要求第五路松平忠辉也莫要轻举妄动。他葫芦里究竟卖的什么药？

paragraphs.source_en: There can be no doubt that the Western Army owed its safe withdrawal that day to Date Masamune.

units.source_en: There can be no doubt that the Western Army owed its safe withdrawal that day to Date Masamune.
units.source_zh: 此日西军能够安全撤退，毋庸置疑，乃是因为伊达政宗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此日西军能够安全撤退，毋庸置疑，乃是因为伊达政宗。

paragraphs.source_en: Sanada Yukimura paused briefly in the woods at Honda. Seeing that Matsudaira Tadateru still made no move, he ordered Mōri Katsunaga's arquebus corps to cover the rear and set fire to nearby homes, feigning an attack while actually seizing the chance to withdraw.

units.source_en: Sanada Yukimura paused briefly in the woods at Honda. Seeing that Matsudaira Tadateru still made no move, he ordered Mōri Katsunaga's arquebus corps to cover the rear and set fire to nearby homes, feigning an attack while actually seizing the chance to withdraw.
units.source_zh: 真田幸村在誉田的树林中稍作停留，见松平忠辉依然按兵不动，遂令毛利胜永的火枪营断后，并放火烧了附近民宅，佯为进攻之相，实则乘机撤兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 真田幸村在誉田的树林中稍作停留，见松平忠辉依然按兵不动，遂令毛利胜永的火枪营断后，并放火烧了附近民宅，佯为进攻之相，实则乘机撤兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus ended the fighting on the sixth day of the fifth month.

units.source_en: Thus ended the fighting on the sixth day of the fifth month.
units.source_zh: 五月初六的战事就这样结束。

paragraphs.source_zh: 五月初六的战事就这样结束。

paragraphs.source_en: That day, Hidetada's army advanced to Senzuka, where Tōdō's troops had camped the previous night, while Ieyasu marched from Hoshida to Hiraoka and made camp there.

units.source_en: That day, Hidetada's army advanced to Senzuka, where Tōdō's troops had camped the previous night, while Ieyasu marched from Hoshida to Hiraoka and made camp there.
units.source_zh: 此日，秀忠的军队进至前夜藤堂部驻扎的千冢，家康则从星田行军至枚冈，安营于此。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此日，秀忠的军队进至前夜藤堂部驻扎的千冢，家康则从星田行军至枚冈，安营于此。

paragraphs.source_en: Tōdō Takatora's messengers came separately to the camps at Senzuka and Hiraoka and petitioned, “Our forces suffered grievous casualties in today's battle. We beg leave to relinquish tomorrow's vanguard and ask that the Shogun and the retired lord grant their consent.”

units.source_en: Tōdō Takatora's messengers came separately to the camps at Senzuka and Hiraoka and petitioned, “Our forces suffered grievous casualties in today's battle. We beg leave to relinquish tomorrow's vanguard and ask that the Shogun and the retired lord grant their consent.”
units.source_zh: 藤堂高虎的使者分别来到千冢和枚冈的帐中，请道：“今日一战，我军死伤惨重，恳请辞去明日的先锋一任，还望将军和大御所应允。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 藤堂高虎的使者分别来到千冢和枚冈的帐中，请道：“今日一战，我军死伤惨重，恳请辞去明日的先锋一任，还望将军和大御所应允。”

paragraphs.source_en: For a warrior of that age, serving in the vanguard was the highest honor. That Tōdō asked to relinquish it showed how crushing a blow he had suffered in that day's battle.

units.source_en: For a warrior of that age, serving in the vanguard was the highest honor. That Tōdō asked to relinquish it showed how crushing a blow he had suffered in that day's battle.
units.source_zh: 对于此际武将来说，先锋乃是至高名誉，藤堂却提出辞去先锋，可想而知，他在此日的战事中受到的打击是如何之大。

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于此际武将来说，先锋乃是至高名誉，藤堂却提出辞去先锋，可想而知，他在此日的战事中受到的打击是如何之大。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu therefore reassigned Tōdō Takatora and Ii Naotaka to Hidetada's forward force and appointed Maeda Toshitsune to the vanguard at Okayama. By then, Maeda Toshitsune had reached Kyūhōji on the Osaka highway and established his position there.

units.source_en: Ieyasu therefore reassigned Tōdō Takatora and Ii Naotaka to Hidetada's forward force and appointed Maeda Toshitsune to the vanguard at Okayama.
units.source_zh: 于是，家康便改任藤堂高虎和井伊直孝为秀忠先头部队，任前田利常为冈山先锋。

units.source_en: By then, Maeda Toshitsune had reached Kyūhōji on the Osaka highway and established his position there.
units.source_zh: 此际前田利常已至大坂官道的久宝寺，驻阵于此。

paragraphs.source_zh: 于是，家康便改任藤堂高虎和井伊直孝为秀忠先头部队，任前田利常为冈山先锋。此际前田利常已至大坂官道的久宝寺，驻阵于此。

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, Sanada Yukimura, having withdrawn safely to Chausuyama, was utterly exhausted, yet immediately summoned the commanders to council. It was already late at night, yet they still did not know how heavy the losses among their various units had been.

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Sanada Yukimura, having withdrawn safely to Chausuyama, was utterly exhausted, yet immediately summoned the commanders to council.

ja.t: していたにもかかわらず、ただちに

units.source_zh: 却说平安撤至茶磨山的真田幸村，虽已精疲力竭，却依然立刻召众将议事。

units.source_en: It was already late at night, yet they still did not know how heavy the losses among their various units had been.
units.source_zh: 时已是深夜，然而他们仍不清楚己方各路损失有多大。

paragraphs.source_zh: 却说平安撤至茶磨山的真田幸村，虽已精疲力竭，却依然立刻召众将议事。时已是深夜，然而他们仍不清楚己方各路损失有多大。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōtani Yoshihisa, Watanabe Kurōdo-no-suke, Igi Tōo, and Fukushima Masamori, who had retreated close behind Yukimura, arrived at the camp one after another and presented themselves before him. Every man was exhausted and haggard; rather than make them devise plans for tomorrow's battle at once, it seemed better to let them rest awhile.

units.source_en: Ōtani Yoshihisa, Watanabe Kurōdo-no-suke, Igi Tōo, and Fukushima Masamori, who had retreated close behind Yukimura, arrived at the camp one after another and presented themselves before him. Every man was exhausted and haggard; rather than make them devise plans for tomorrow's battle at once, it seemed better to let them rest awhile.

ja.t: えさせるより、しばらく
ませたほうがよかった。

units.source_zh: 紧跟在幸村之后撤退的大谷吉久、渡边内藏助、伊木远雄、福岛正守，陆续来到营中，见过了幸村，个个亦都精疲力竭，形容憔悴，与其让他们现在思量明日的用兵之策，莫如让他们稍事歇息。

paragraphs.source_zh: 紧跟在幸村之后撤退的大谷吉久、渡边内藏助、伊木远雄、福岛正守，陆续来到营中，见过了幸村，个个亦都精疲力竭，形容憔悴，与其让他们现在思量明日的用兵之策，莫如让他们稍事歇息。

paragraphs.source_en: “When everyone has arrived, I shall wake you. Until then, sleep for a while.”

units.source_en: “When everyone has arrived, I shall wake you. Until then, sleep for a while.”
units.source_zh: “等众人都到齐了，我再叫醒你们，此前你们先睡片刻。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “等众人都到齐了，我再叫醒你们，此前你们先睡片刻。”

paragraphs.source_en: The men gathered around a feebly flickering campfire, and before long loud snores arose. Mōri Katsunaga and his son Katsushige entered the tent first; Yoshida Yoshikore, Kimura Muneaki, Shinohara Tadateru, Ishikawa Sadamori, Asai Nagafusa, and Takeda Eiō followed afterward. Soon the tent resounded with snores.

units.source_en: The men gathered around a feebly flickering campfire, and before long loud snores arose.
units.source_zh: 众人围于一堆火苗微弱的篝火旁，未久便鼾声大作。

units.source_en: Mōri Katsunaga and his son Katsushige entered the tent first; Yoshida Yoshikore, Kimura Muneaki, Shinohara Tadateru, Ishikawa Sadamori, Asai Nagafusa, and Takeda Eiō followed afterward.
units.source_zh: 毛利胜永与其子胜荣入帐在前，吉田好是、木村宗明、筱原忠照、石川贞矩、浅井长房、竹田永翁进帐在后。

units.source_en: Soon the tent resounded with snores.
units.source_zh: 未几，营帐中鼾声四起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人围于一堆火苗微弱的篝火旁，未久便鼾声大作。毛利胜永与其子胜荣入帐在前，吉田好是、木村宗明、筱原忠照、石川贞矩、浅井长房、竹田永翁进帐在后。未几，营帐中鼾声四起。

paragraphs.source_en: Yamakawa Kenshin went to meet Ōno Harufusa. When Harufusa reached the command tent under the escort of thirty Negoro warrior monks, Yukimura at last woke the commanders to discuss how they would fight the next day.

units.source_en: Yamakawa Kenshin went to meet Ōno Harufusa.
units.source_zh: 山川贤信前去迎接大野治房。

units.source_en: When Harufusa reached the command tent under the escort of thirty Negoro warrior monks, Yukimura at last woke the commanders to discuss how they would fight the next day.
units.source_zh: 当治房在三十名根来僧兵的护送下来到大帐时，幸村这才叫醒诸将，商讨明日如何用兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 山川贤信前去迎接大野治房。当治房在三十名根来僧兵的护送下来到大帐时，幸村这才叫醒诸将，商讨明日如何用兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Though it was called a council, the commanders, who had fought all day, offered no worthwhile ideas. Each of them knew in his heart that the war was already lost. The enemy still had a host of able warriors who had yet to enter the fray, while most of their own men had already been committed. Set side by side, the outcome was plain.

units.source_en: Though it was called a council, the commanders, who had fought all day, offered no worthwhile ideas.

ja.t: たちから、これといった

units.source_zh: 虽说是议事，打了一天仗的将领们并未提出什么像样的见解。

units.source_en: Each of them knew in his heart that the war was already lost.
units.source_zh: 他们每人心里都清楚，这一战已无望。
